div.head: III Eg 6
div.ab: ⁊ finde him ælc man, þæt he borh hæbbe; ⁊ se borh hine þonne to ælcum rihte gelæde ⁊ geealde.
⁊ finde him ælc man, þæt he borh hæbbe; ⁊ se borh hine þonne to ælcon rihte gelæde ⁊ gehealde.
⁊ finde him ælc man, þæt he borh habbe; ⁊ se borh hine to ælcon rihte (ge)lǽde ⁊ gehealde.
⁊ finde him ælc man, þæt he borh hæbbe; ⁊ se borh hine þonne to ælcon rihte gelæde ⁊ gehealde.
Et omnis homo inueniat sibi plegium; et idem custodiat et ducat eum ad omne rectum.
[Be borgum.] ⁊ finde him ælc man þæt he borh habbe; ⁊ se borh hine to ælcon rihte gelǽde ⁊ gehealde.
And finde him ælc man, þæt he borh hæbbe, and se borh hine þonne to ælcum rihte gelæde and gehealde.
(Von Bürgen. Ld) Und jedermann versehe sich, dass er [für sich] Bürgschaft habe; und dieser Bürge stelle und halte ihn dann fest zu jeder Rechtspflicht.
(Of sureties. Ld) And let every man provide himself so that he has a surety; and let that surety then bring and hold him to every legal obligation.
And every man shall see that he has a surety, and this surety shall bring and keep him to [the performance of] every lawful duty.
And each man is to provide himself with a surety, and the surety is to produce and hold him to every legal duty.
And each person is to find a surety for himself, and this surety shall lead and hold him to each of his legal obligations.
